parsed.post: Massive improvement! DEPTH=8 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' with a slight LR reduction and warmup dropped val_bpb to 0.8363. This confirms that higher capacity combined with data and stable optimization is the way. Next, I'll explore the ASPECT_RATIO and WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Refining the high-capacity regime: decreasing learning rate further for stability, adding 5% warmup, and introducing a small amount of weight decay.
